items.name: Big Teens Naija
items.overview:
Big Teens Naija is a Nigerian youth reality television show designed to discover, nurture, celebrate and showcase the talents, creativity, intelligence and ingenuity of young Nigerians between the ages of 13 and 19.

Built around the theme “Ingenuity of the African Child,” the show brings together teenagers from diverse backgrounds to live, learn, compete and collaborate in a structured and entertaining reality-TV environment.

Through talent showcases, creative and intellectual challenges, team activities, entrepreneurship, leadership tasks and other engaging competitions, contestants will have the opportunity to express themselves, discover their strengths, develop confidence and build valuable life skills.

items.name: Mera Ghar
items.overview: Mera Ghar is a family drama centered on Sherry, the youngest member of a household, who is raised by his elder sister Farkhanda after their mother's death. Having devoted her life to him.

items.name: Lipistic
items.overview: A bride with secret and scars. A lipstick with power that people would kill for. And a rich man with dark desire. When three worlds collide in this tale of love, lust and power, nobody can escape unscathed.

items.name: Loud Eyes
items.overview: A documentary-style reality show about starting and running a business in the Chaoshan region of Guangdong, with Lou Yixiao, Jiang Yiyi, Gao Zhiting, Li Zhenning, Cao Enqi, Gao Siwen and AK Liu Zhang as the regular cast.

items.name: Plein
items.overview: For Philipp Plein, more is more. Between Cannes, New York, Milan, and L.A., he drives his fashion empire forward-and pushes everyone around him to their limits. But while his girlfriend Andreea struggles with her health and his mother Hanne stands up to him, the very thing that matters most to Philipp begins to falter: control.

A wealthy Morrish Baron and his orphanage at the center of it all.

items.name: Per and Marie – The Story of Roxette
items.original_name: Per och Marie - historien om Roxette
items.overview: A brand-new documentary series chronicles the success story of Roxette—one of Sweden’s greatest musical triumphs of all time. Together, friends Per Gessle and Marie Fredriksson created a unique and unrivaled collection of pop gems—a musical treasure trove, beginning in 1986, that lives on to this day. Through their own personal footage, photographs, and voices, we are taken on a journey from Halmstad to sold-out arenas across the globe.

items.name: I Became the Killer's Prey
items.overview: On an otherwise ordinary afternoon, 'Jun-hwi' encounters a killer who has broken into an empty house. Having lost a friend and now finding himself the killer's next target, he chooses not to flee-but instead prepares a dangerous counterattack...!

items.name: The Altruists
items.overview: The story of Sam Bankman-Fried and Caroline Ellison, two hyper-smart, ambitious young idealists who tried to remake the global financial system in the blink of an eye - before they were accused of stealing $8 billion and became Gen Z's own Bonnie & Clyde.

items.name: Sound:Track
items.overview: It is an anthology consisting of eight independent stories that explore moments of love, separation, and personal growth through “that song”—a song that everyone has encountered at least once in their life.

items.name: The AJ Styles Podcast
items.overview: WWE Hall of Famer AJ Styles welcomes WWE Superstars and Legends to revisit memorable matches and hidden gems from the WWE Vault. Through watchalongs and conversations, Styles and his guests share behind-the-scenes stories, personal memories, and insights into some of professional wrestling's most unforgettable moments.

items.name: Ós Blauw
items.overview: A five-part series about police work in Heerlen, following five officers from the Heerlen base team—Farid, Tanja, Jeroen, Sander, and Rachel—as they go about their daily duties.

items.name: Gangster
items.overview: Manouchehr and Nosrat, the family's good-for-nothing, unemployed sons, turn to gangster antics to win over the father of Haydeh and Homayra. But this is no ordinary game!

items.name: Inventeur Gadget - Les 1000 vies de Jean Chalopin
items.original_name: Inventeur Gadget - Les 1000 vies de Jean Chalopin

items.name: Sweet Homes
items.overview: What starts as an idea between friends quickly becomes their biggest gamble yet. Together, they set out to build a million-dollar dream home on Alabama's Smith Lake before summer's end, betting that years of friendship are enough to see them through.

items.name: Gordon
items.overview: Aníbal Gordon rises from a small-time thief to a convicted murderer in Argentina during the '70s.

items.name: Lo Chudail Chali Sasural
items.overview: Urvashi, a chudail longing for a human family, marries Aarav Patel and joins his lively Gujarati joint family. As her magic causes hilarious mishaps, Aarav struggles to protect her secret while her human-hating mother Kamini fuels the chaos. Amid magical mayhem, and family drama, love finds a way.

items.name: Friz i Wersow. W drodze
items.overview: The production will follow Friz and Wersow as they embark on a new chapter in their lives—as parents of two children, business partners, and a couple ready to confront previously untold aspects of their own story. The six-part documentary series will premiere exclusively on Prime Video later this year.

items.name: Mr & Mrs Office
items.overview: Mr & Mrs Office explores the comedic and chaotic worlds of work-life balance, relationships, and corporate dynamics. The plot centers around a couple navigating the daily grind, combining relatable office tropes with domestic humor and romance.

items.name: Win the Mall
items.overview: Ten teams move into a mall where they must conquer storefronts, forge alliances and outsmart rivals to win $1 million in this reality competition series.

items.name: Pieces of Guilt
items.overview: Detective Qin Yuejian uses her extraordinary photographic memory to solve difficult cases, despite the burden of constantly reliving every detail. When newly transferred officer Liang Wan becomes her partner, the two work together to investigate bizarre crimes while confronting secrets from their pasts.

items.name: El doble
items.overview: "El doble" is a hybrid format that combines the documentary genre with musical entertainment across three episodes. Hosted by producer Jordi Cubino, the show aims to find, select, and train a contemporary performer capable of reviving the Eurodance music phenomenon of the 1980s. Through a casting and preparation process, the program recreates the success and cultural impact that Cubino himself experienced during that decade under the stage name David Lyme.

items.name: The Law of Beasts
items.overview: When the case of a child serial killer resurfaces after 25 years as an unresolved legal and social problem, two former friends are forced to confront the choices that broke their friendship and shaped their lives.

items.name: Small Town Trouble: Texas
items.overview: Set in Boerne, Texas, the series follows a charming yet unconventional group of mothers and social insiders and their husbands as conservative small-town values collide with forbidden attraction, messy friendships, and shocking secrets. Here, perception is everything, temptation is everywhere, and the truth is never as buttoned-up as it looks.

items.name: Her Willing Subject
items.overview: Reborn after a tragic end in their previous lives, Lu Qingcang and Shen Shuying resume their rivalry as regent and empress, but find themselves drawn together as they gradually uncover the truth.

items.name: Valentina and the 12 Signs
items.overview: After a devastating breakup, Valentina decides to date one man from every zodiac sign. But the universe has other plans.

items.name: Taming the Husband
items.overview: Amid the turmoil of canal transport and court politics, butcher’s daughter Jin Baozhu is forced into marriage with Xie Yan, the disgraced and disabled heir of a powerful shipping family. What begins as a relationship built on conflict gradually turns into an alliance, as the two navigate mounting dangers and personal struggles.

items.name: Ring My Bell: Reboot
items.overview: The phone lines are open and your favorite Drag Race queens are taking your calls!

items.name: Yirshawn
items.overview: The stuffed animal world show

items.name: Dale Thalith
items.overview: ​A thrilling Egyptian drama series revolving around complex and intertwined conflicts that raise deep human and social questions, pushing the characters into critical situations that reveal hidden secrets and alter the course of events

items.name: The Fourth Seat
items.overview: Three men must solve the suspicious and sudden disappearance of their business associate—when he decided to disappear, he never planned to stay gone.

items.name: Phoenix Rising from the Faint Moon
items.overview: A modern researcher travels to an ancient dynasty after an experimental accident, where she becomes a prince's wife and discovers a mysterious connection to the assassin targeting him.

items.name: Masked Dancer
items.overview: After reopening the Nishang Pavilion and gaining fame in the capital, dancer Xiao Miaomiao becomes entangled in the schemes of the Wei household while secretly seeking to clear her father's name.

items.name: Elke Donker Wolk
items.overview: When Johan Joubert joins a support group for the bereaved, he meets André, whose wife has been lying in a hospital coma for two years with severe brain damage. Their friendship appears coincidental, but is actually pre-planned. One of the two men has a hidden agenda, while the other harbors a dark secret of his own. Together, they must learn to process devastating loss.

items.name: The Circle
items.overview: This social experiment brings together everyday players and celebrities to compete side by side in a game of popularity where identity is ever-changing, and anyone can be anyone. Filmed in real time, the series gives viewers exclusive access as twists and player ratings unfold, with audience votes shaping the game. This fresh take supercharges the original's signature mix of strategy and deception into an addictive experience built for today's always-on audience.

items.name: He Said, She Said: Till Death Do Us Part
items.original_name: He Said, She Said: Till Death Do Us Part
items.overview: Follows a no-holds-barred custody battle between two high-powered lawyers, which extends beyond the courtroom into social media and the court of public opinion.

items.name: BLACKTIDE
items.overview: Two billion people took a longevity cure. On Day 28, every green wristband became a beacon. Told through the recovered logs of Miami trauma surgeon Dr. Maria, BLACKTIDE follows an ancient deep-sea organism pulled from Challenger Deep as a global quarantine collapses from the inside.

This fresh take supercharges the original's signature mix of strategy and deception into an addictive experience built for today's always-on audience.
